source: pdfsource/_pages_thyroidv8/ (T/N criteria on p1-p2; anaplastic stage table on p5)

tumor_size_cm.description: Greatest dimension of the primary thyroid tumor in centimeters. Drives T1a/T1b/T2/T3a when there is no extrathyroidal extension. Absence prevents firing any size-dependent intrathyroidal rule and falls through to TX.

extrathyroidal_extension.description: Greatest extent of gross extrathyroidal extension. 'none' = intrathyroidal (T is driven by size). 'strap_muscles' = T3b. 'soft_tissue_or_larynx_trachea_esophagus_or_RLN' = T4a. 'prevertebral_fascia_or_carotid_or_mediastinal_vessels' = T4b.

choices.strap_muscles: Strap muscles only (sternohyoid / sternothyroid / thyrohyoid / omohyoid) -- T3b
choices.soft_tissue_or_larynx_trachea_esophagus_: Subcutaneous soft tissue, larynx, trachea, esophagus, or recurrent laryngeal nerve -- T4a
choices.prevertebral_fascia_or_carotid_or_medias: Prevertebral fascia, carotid artery, or mediastinal vessels -- T4b

positive_node_count.description: Number of regional lymph nodes with metastasis. 0 -> N0; >= 1 -> N1 (subcategory chosen by node_region).

node_region.description: Anatomic region of the positive regional nodes. 'central_compartment' = levels VI/VII (pretracheal, paratracheal, prelaryngeal/Delphian, upper mediastinal) -> N1a. 'lateral_neck_or_retropharyngeal' = levels I-V or retropharyngeal -> N1b.

choices.lateral_neck_or_retropharyngeal: Lateral neck (levels I-V) or retropharyngeal -- N1b

T.label: T4b: gross ETE into prevertebral fascia / carotid / mediastinal vessels
T4a: gross ETE into subcutaneous soft tissue, larynx, trachea, esophagus, or RLN
T3b: gross ETE into strap muscles only

N.label: N1b: positive nodes in lateral neck (levels I-V) or retropharyngeal
N1a: positive nodes in central compartment (level VI/VII)

examples.label: 0.8 cm intrathyroidal, no nodes -> T1a, N0, M0
3 cm intrathyroidal, 1 central-compartment node -> T2, N1a, M0
5 cm intrathyroidal, 2 lateral-neck nodes -> T3a, N1b, M0
trachea/larynx invasion + distant mets -> T4a, N0, M1
carotid encasement -> T4b regardless of size
